name: Yelena Belova

abilityDetails.Endurance: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki yeni hasarsız debuff'ların süresini azaltır.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Instant Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Reversal: Uygulayan şampiyondaki Stun etkilerini kaldırır, gelen saldırıyı durdurur ve rakibi yere seren sert bir karşı vuruşla misilleme yapar.
abilityDetails.Bleed Vulnerability: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Impact: Blok Nüfuzunu (Block Penetration) belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Disarm: Saldırı gücü ve blok yeterliliğinin belirli bir seviyenin üzerine çıkmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Critical Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Gözlem modunda rakibin saldırısını %60, kritik gücünü %50 azaltır. Combo metresi çeşitli aksiyonlarla artar (vurulunca +1, intercept'te +4, E1 bloklanınca +5, özel/ağır saldırı kullanılınca +10, temel vuruşla %50 cana düşerse +50). 100'de Eliminasyon Moduna girer (hafif/ağır vuruşla veya E1 sonrası vurulunca inversion tetikler, tüm vuruşları garanti kritik olur). Susto (fear) efektli şampiyonlar koruma bonusunu tamamen kaldırır — en büyük zayıflığı bu. Eliminasyon Modundayken bloğuna vurmak (19 vuruş) combo metresini erkenden sıfırlar — bunun dışında modu önlemenin yolu yok.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Cover All Contingencies
While Yelena is in Observation mode, her target's Critical Damage Rating is capped at [90 - 50]% of what it was at the start of the fight.
While Yelena is in Elimination Mode, her target cannot Evade or cause attacks to Miss. No effect against Mutant Champions.

abilitySections.title: Endure the Red Room
content: Yelena is Immune to Poison effects.
At the start of each fight, Yelena gains an indefinite Combo Shield Passive and a 35% Endurance Passive. These Passives are unaffected by Ability Accuracy reductions.

abilitySections.title: Train to Strike
content: Yelena can land Critical Hits through her target's Block.
Critical Hits inflict an Instant Bleed dealing a burst of [2,273.14] Direct Damage.
If this Instant Bleed is prevented by an Immunity, deal a burst of [2,983.96] Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Observe the Target
content: Yelena starts each fight in Observation Mode, capping her target's Attack Rating at 60% of what it was at the start of the fight. While Yelena is suffering from a Daunted effect, this cap becomes 100%.
While Observation Mode is active, Yelena gains:
+1 Combo Meter each time the Defender is struck by or Blocks a Basic Attack, or +4 if the attack was an Intercept.
+10 Combo Meter each time the Defender is knocked down.
+50 Combo Meter the first time the Defender is brought below 50% Health during any Basic Attack.

abilitySections.title: Eliminate the Target
content: When Yelena's Combo Meter reaches 100+, she switches from Observation to Elimination Mode after 10 seconds. Activating a Special Attack ends this timer early. When Yelena's Combo Meter falls below 5, she switches back to Observation Mode.
While Elimination Mode is active:
Yelena loses 5 Combo Meter each time either Champion is struck by or Blocks a Basic Attack.
All of Yelena's attacks are Guaranteed Critical Hits.
Yelena's personal abilities are unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
When Yelena would be struck by a Light or Heavy Attack, she executes a Reversal, inflicts 4 Instant Bleeds, then loses 15 Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit inflicts a 40% Bleed Vulnerability Debuff for 18 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 3.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain an Impact Passive increasing Block Penetration by [2,250] for 10 seconds.
Observation: While this Impact is active, Yelena gains +5 Combo Meter each time she hits her target's Block.
Elimination: While this Impact is active, Yelena can execute a Reversal against Medium Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a non-stacking Disarm Passive for 15 seconds. This can be inflicted through Block.
Observation: Inflicting Disarm grants +50 Combo Meter.
Elimination: Inflicting Disarm refreshes all Bleed Vulnerability effects then pauses them for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Critical Bleed Passive dealing [15,985.5] Direct Damage multiplied by Yelena's Critical Damage Multiplier over 12 seconds. This Bleed starts paused for 12 seconds if Yelena's target is Indestructible or below 5% Max Health.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Cover All Contingencies
content: While Yelena is in Observation mode, her target's Critical Damage Rating is capped at [90 - 50]% of what it was at the start of the fight.
While Yelena is in Elimination Mode, her target cannot Evade or cause attacks to Miss. No effect against Mutant Champions.
